title: Donald Trump doesn’t just love billionaires, he loves multimillionaires too

paragraphs.en: After the House passed its version of Donald Trump ’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) last year – the one that paired a $5tn-plus tax cut with $1tn-plus of cuts from food stamps and Medicaid – the House speaker, Mike Johnson , explained that “this is not giving tax cuts to the millionaires”. The beneficiaries, he said, were “small business owners” that “provide the jobs in every community in America”.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，在众议院通过其版本的唐纳德·特朗普《一项大而美的法案》（One Big Beautiful Bill Act，OBBBA）——该法案将超过5万亿美元的减税与削减超过1万亿美元的食品券和医疗补助（Medicaid）资金捆绑在一起——之后，众议院议长迈克·约翰逊（Mike Johnson）解释说，“这不是在给百万富翁减税”。他说，受益者是“小企业主”，他们“为美国每个社区提供了就业岗位”。

paragraphs.en: Johnson was playing to the myth of the modest, sturdy Main Street job creator. It is an appealing story. It’s also the most consequential piece of BS distorting American policy that deprives the government of tax revenue, stunts American capitalism, twists regulations, thwarts competition and overwhelmingly serves millionaires’ interests.
paragraphs.zh: 约翰逊是在迎合关于谦逊、坚韧的美国主街就业创造者的神话。这是个引人入胜的故事。它也是扭曲美国政策的最有影响的谎言：它使政府丧失税收收入，阻碍美国资本主义发展，扭曲监管，压制竞争，并在极大程度上服务于百万富翁的利益。

paragraphs.en: The speaker was specifically talking about “pass through” businesses. About 95% of businesses in the country take this form. They employ half of all workers and generate more than half the nation’s business income. These creatures of the tax code are freed from paying the corporate income tax rate. Instead, their untaxed profits are distributed to their owners, who generally face lower individual tax rates, saving them billions.
paragraphs.zh: 这位议长具体谈论的是“穿透”（pass-through）型企业。美国约95%的企业采用这种形式。它们雇佣了一半的工人，创造了全国超过一半的企业收入。这些税法产物无需缴纳公司所得税。相反，它们未纳税的利润被分配给所有者，而所有者通常适用较低的个人税率，这为他们节省了数十亿美元。

paragraphs.en: Related: Trump has amassed staggering wealth in ‘most openly corrupt’ presidency
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：特朗普在“最公然腐败”的总统任期内积累了惊人的财富

paragraphs.en: Republicans have consistently gone to bat for pass throughs. In 2017 Ron Johnson, the Republican senator from Wisconsin, threatened not to vote for Trump’s Tax Cut and Jobs Act, relenting only after the Senate increased a tax deduction for pass-through business income from 17% to 20%. “I just have it in my heart a real affinity for these owner-operated pass-throughs,” Johnson said at the time .
paragraphs.zh: 共和党人一直在为穿透型企业奔走。2017年，威斯康星州共和党参议员罗恩·约翰逊（Ron Johnson）威胁不为特朗普的《减税与就业法案》（Tax Cut and Jobs Act）投票，直到参议院将穿透型企业收入的税收抵扣从17%提高到20%才作罢。“我只是发自内心地对这些业主经营的穿透型企业怀有真正的亲近感，”约翰逊当时说。

paragraphs.en: That deduction, made permanent in the ”big beautiful bill” last year, will cost the budget $820bn over a 10-year period, almost as much as was cut from the Medicaid budget.
paragraphs.zh: 这一税收抵扣在去年的“大而美的法案”中被永久化，将在10年内使预算损失8200亿美元，几乎相当于从医疗补助预算中削减的金额。

paragraphs.en: About 57% of the $1.3tn in pass-through income in 2022 went to 890,000 people in the richest 1% of the population, according to the Urban-Brookings Tax Policy Center. A study by economists at the Department of the Treasury, the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis and Dartmouth University found that 35% of the total deductions in the year after the 2017 tax cut, a cold $54bn, flowed to taxpayers with income of at least $1m.
paragraphs.zh: 根据城市-布鲁金斯税收政策中心（Urban-Brookings Tax Policy Center）的数据，2022年1.3万亿美元的穿透型收入中，约57%流向了人口中最富有的1%，即89万人。美国财政部、明尼阿波利斯联邦储备银行（Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis）和达特茅斯大学（Dartmouth University）经济学家的一项研究发现，2017年减税后一年内的全部税收抵扣中，有35%——足足540亿美元——流向了收入至少100万美元的纳税人。

paragraphs.en: Johnson and Johnson know this. Senator Ron owned a stake in a pass-through, a plastics maker in Oshkosh, which he sold in 2020 for between $5 and $25m and upon which he built a fortune worth about $40m in 2018 , making him the sixth-richest senator at the time. Speaker Mike, a man of “ modest means ”, lives in a $3.7m townhouse steps from the US Capitol owned by the millionaire Republican donor Lee Beaman , who made his fortune from a string of car dealerships.
paragraphs.zh: 约翰逊和约翰逊对此心知肚明。参议员罗恩曾持有一家穿透型企业的股份，那是奥什科什（Oshkosh）的一家塑料制造商。他于2020年以500万至2500万美元的价格将其出售，并以此在2018年积累了约4000万美元的财富，使他成为当时最富有的六位参议员之一。自称“财力中等”的议长迈克住在一栋价值370万美元的联排别墅里，距离美国国会大厦仅几步之遥，这栋房子归百万富翁共和党捐助者李·比曼（Lee Beaman）所有，后者靠一系列汽车经销店发家。
